spec_match.rationale: Uses the real toHex() on every input change; stats derived from the actual bytes.

interactive.rationale: Three samples + free typing rebuild the grid; clicking a byte highlights it (verified via CDP: exactly one .highlight after click).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb corrected 2026-08-30 — it previously promised that clicking a hex byte highlights the corresponding input character, which the page never did; it highlights the byte cell itself.

edge_cases.rationale: Multi-byte UTF-8 is colour-coded (lead vs continuation), but fromHex() — half the feature pair named in the snippet — is never executed by the page, and odd-length/invalid hex behavior is not shown.

conformance.rationale: Suite pins toHex/fromHex existence and the lossless hex round-trip; passes live.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless via CDP/puppeteer 2026-08-30 (feature natively supported — shipped Chrome 140): every button/sample/control driven, DOM readouts verified after each action, console clean (only sandbox-blocked external font fetch), zero page overflow at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3, full-page screenshots read.

design_system.rationale: Variables throughout; highlight state inverts both background and color; multibyte-3/4 classes are defined but unused (dead CSS, harmless).

accessibility.rationale: Hex byte cells are click-only spans — not focusable, no role or accessible name beyond a title attribute — so the inspection interaction is unavailable to keyboard/screen-reader users; stats bar is text, which helps.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Grid wraps; zero overflow both classes.

openQuestions.title: Exercise fromHex() and its error contract interactively
openQuestions.detail: Add a hex-input field that decodes via Uint8Array.fromHex, showing case-insensitivity and the SyntaxError on odd length/invalid digits that the snippet claims.

openQuestions.title: Make hex cells keyboard-accessible
openQuestions.detail: Cells respond only to click; give them button semantics (or a roving tabindex) and an accessible name like 'byte 5, 0x8e', so the highlight interaction works without a pointer.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive demo layout without horizontal overflow mobile touch targets
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Design tokens, adequate touch targets, visible focus, honest capability handling.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Pages already use CSS variables throughout; verified zero page overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 for all six concepts; fixes kept the existing token-based styling.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP probe: documentElement.scrollWidth - clientWidth == 0 on all 6 concepts, both classes

guidanceConsulted.query: status message live region labelled form controls
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label controls; surface state changes as text; keep native elements for keyboard support.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Existing labels/aria-labels verified; remaining gaps (status bars not aria-live, hex cells click-only) recorded as open questions rather than silently passed.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: page source review + CDP interaction transcript 2026-08-30

summary: toHex path verified live (12-byte emoji sample: 8 multi-byte cells coloured, click-highlight works). Blurb mismatch fixed on the feature index 2026-08-30; fromHex remains display-only — recorded as the top follow-up.
